subject: Why do we need plyr when we have reshape2?

messages.author: c102ef7f5617067f
messages.subject: Why do we need plyr when we have reshape2?
parts: I feel I'm fairly familiar with plyr and more recently have been exploring reshape2. My impression that reshape2 can do many tasks that plyr can do. So why is it necessary to have plyr in addition to reshape2? Or in other words, what can plyr do that reshape2 can't?

Hi,

The capabilities of plyr are described in http://www.jstatsoft.org/v40/i01/

I don't think there is a lot of overlap, but I'd be interested to see some examples.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Why do we need plyr when we have reshape2?
parts:
The focus of reshape2 is on tidying data (e.g.
http://vita.had.co.nz/papers/tidy-data.html). The focus of plyr is on
group-wise manipulation of data. There's some overlap, but not a huge
amount.

Hadley
